name: Raymarched SDF Volume Rendering
aliases: Ray Marching with Signed Distance Fields
definition: A technique to display a 2D projection of a 3D object defined by a mathematical distance function (SDF) by casting rays from the camera and stepping along them until they intersect the surface.
summary: Raymarched SDF Volume Rendering renders 3D scenes defined by implicit surfaces using distance estimates, offering infinite sharpness for procedural geometry without rasterizing triangle meshes.
